faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GMC Jalgaon Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the GMC Jalgaon Assistant Professor recruitment is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies available for the Assistant Professor post at Government Medical College, Jalgaon.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.D./M.S./DNB in the concerned subject as per NMC norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor post is 40 years, with relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Professor position is Rs. 100000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection process methods?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Merit List and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Government Medical College, Jalgaon located?
faq.answer: Government Medical College, Jalgaon is located in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, with the pincode 425001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is जा.क्र.शार्विमज/आस्थापना १-२/सहा.प्राध्या./जाहीरात/करार/३६४ दिवस/ ७७७४/२०२६.
